d: An online campaign called the E20 Janta Party is gaining attention in India over the government's ethanol-blended petrol policy. The movement wants motorists to have the option of buying both pure petrol and E20 fuel, while demanding greater transparency, clearer fuel labelling and more independent studies on vehicle performance. In this video from Firstpost Vantage, Hem Saroya explains how the campaign began, why India's E20 policy was introduced, the concerns raised by some motorists, the government's response, the legal battle involving Union Minister Nitin Gadkari, and why the movement…
